title: Pytest provides fixtures such as tmp_path for per-test temporary files and monkeypatch for automatically restored environment/object mutations, making it suitable for isolated Python unit and integration tests.
Vitest documentation — TypeScript, mocking, coverage, browser features
Vitest is a Vite-native TypeScript-friendly test framework with mocking and coverage support; it is a strong default for modern TypeScript unit and integration tests, especially in Vite-era projects.
Playwright documentation — web-first assertions and cross-browser E2E testing

Playwright supports reliable browser E2E tests with locator-based web-first assertions that retry until conditions are met; it is an appropriate default for web frontend, HTML game, and browser-extension smoke workflows.
General testing pyramid and testing trophy research summary

The testing pyramid favors many fast unit tests, fewer integration tests, and minimal E2E tests, while the testing trophy emphasizes static analysis and more integration tests for modern applications.
